The spots are tiny (1-3mm), roughly circular, and distributed across the leaf. This pattern strongly suggests **Bacterial Speck of Tomato**.

Now I'll view one reference image to confirm.

- Small, dark/black spots scattered across tomato leaves
- Similar size and distribution of lesions
- Yellow halos around some spots
- Even the Bugwood IDs are consecutive (1577156 test vs 1576393 reference), indicating same source/disease
